node.statement: PART VI — GPS MOMENT ANALYSIS (MIXED STATE). Theorem 1.5 (loose): For Mix(GPS) on n copies of a rank-r state rho, E[rho_hat tensor rho_hat] = ((n-1)/n)rho^2 + (1/n)(rho tensor I + I tensor rho)SWAP + (r/n^2)SWAP - Lower_rho. Theorem 1.6 (tight): For Mix+(GPS), the r/n^2 coefficient improves to E[ell(lambda)]/n^2. Proofs via partial trace of pure-state moments through the purification reduction.
